_why_this_file: This candidate is NOT a candidate. mcp-spec is already built and independently measured at 7/53 -> 44/53 (9B) and 7/53 -> 42/53 (4B), beating equally-gated raw-source RAG by +15. It is run through the gate first to VALIDATE THE GATE. An instrument that says DO NOT BUILD for the best pack we have measured is broken, and finding that out on a control costs nothing, whereas finding it out on a real candidate costs a day of authoring.
judge_or_compute: JUDGE. Every constraint here is a protocol decision a model applies by recall — an error code, a field name, a message shape, whether a handshake exists. None of it requires the model to compute anything it cannot compute. No compiler is implied. This is the shape that packs are for, and the contrast with letterpress (whose load-bearing constraints were contrast ratios and layout measurements a model can assert but not evaluate) is the whole point of asking the question.
